purpose: Shows one icon from the curated Material Symbols Sharp set, drawn in the surrounding text colour. Decorative by default; give it a label when the icon alone carries meaning.

props.name: name
props.description: Icon to draw. One of: add, arrow_back, arrow_forward, calendar_today, cancel, check, check_circle, check_small, close, content_copy, delete, download, edit, filter_list, help, info, keyboard_arrow_down, keyboard_arrow_left, keyboard_arrow_right, keyboard_arrow_up, lock, mail, menu, more_horiz, more_vert, open_in_new, person, remove, report, search, settings, upload, visibility, visibility_off, warning.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. Set it only when the icon carries meaning on its own; otherwise the icon is hidden from assistive tech

whenToUse: Beside a text label to help recognition (leading icon in a Button, start icon in an Input)
For status next to a message (report, warning, info, check_circle)
Inside an IconButton for a well-known action such as close, search or more
whenNotToUse: As the only content of a clickable element — use IconButton, which requires a label
For decoration that adds no meaning — leave it out
With an icon outside the curated set — add it to components/icon/icon-list.json and run npm run icons:build
antiPatterns: Pasting raw <svg> markup into a component instead of using Icon
Giving a decorative icon a label, so screen readers announce it twice
Colouring an icon with a hardcoded value instead of the text colour

anatomy: A square SVG box with one path from Material Symbols Sharp (weight 600), viewBox 0 -960 960 960
typography: Not text; pairs with 16px icons beside `type-caption-size` and `type-label-size` text, 20px beside `type-body1-size` text
states: Colour is currentColor, so it follows the text colour and every state of its parent control
motion: None of its own; inherits its parent's colour transition

a11yNotes: Decorative by default: aria-hidden and not focusable
With label: role img and aria-label
Never the only content of a control — IconButton supplies the accessible name
Icons drawn at 3:1 or better against their background when they carry meaning (WCAG 1.4.11)
